title: monardella macrantha var. nana
intro: Monardella macrantha var. nana, commonly known as Dwarf Bush Beaver Tail, is a perennial shrub in the mint family (Lamiaceae) native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory effects, which can aid in wound healing and reducing pain. The therapeutic actions of Monardella macrantha var. nana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including rosmarinic acid, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to possess antioxidant and anti-cancer properties.
